soap.subjective: Patient reports recurrent afternoon tightness across lateral cheekbones and flare-ups following outdoor sun exposure. Experiencing dullness and mild flaking around nasal crevices.
soap.objective: AI Biomarker scan revealed Hydration index 72% (mild sub-surface water loss) and Redness 88% (elevated microvascular reactivity). Stratum corneum thickness shows mild lipid compromise. No active cystic papules detected.
soap.assessment: Type III barrier impairment driven by transepidermal moisture loss and UV-induced capillary fragility. Skin demonstrates high cellular responsiveness.
soap.plan:
1. Layer multi-molecular hyaluronic acid AM/PM under lipid ceramide cream.
2. Prescribe 10% Azelaic Acid + Centella Asiatica serum for erythema control.
3. Broad-spectrum Mineral SPF 50 reapplication every 3 hours.
4. Follow-up digital scan review in 4 weeks.

disclaimer: Cosmetic wellness guidance, not a medical diagnosis. Formulations provided for skin barrier optimization.
